description: This file manages a queue of pending work items for nodes, including functions to enqueue, drain, acknowledge, and reset pending work, with prioritization and expiration handling.

methods.name: getOrCreateState
methods.description: Retrieves existing or creates new state for a given node ID.

methods.name: pruneExpired
methods.description: Removes expired items from node's pending work state.

methods.name: pruneStateIfEmpty
methods.description: Deletes node state if no pending items remain.

methods.name: sortedItems
methods.description: Returns pending items sorted by priority, creation time, and ID.

methods.name: makeBaselineStatusItem
methods.description: Creates a default status request item.
